gameLobbyMd:
# Battle Arena

Waiting for the host to start the battle.

## How to play

1. **Move** using the joystick on the left
2. **Attack** enemies in your facing direction with the sword button
3. **Shield** to block one hit (5 sec cooldown after absorbing)
4. **Ranged Attack** fires a projectile in your facing direction (3 sec cooldown)
5. **Power-ups** spawn on the field — grab health, damage boosts, or shields!
6. Last player (or team) standing wins!

> *Your AI-generated avatar will appear on the arena!*

menuHelpMd:
# Help

## How to Play

1. Join the game using the provided link or QR code.
2. Enter your name and describe your character.
3. AI will generate a unique avatar for you!
4. Use the joystick to move and buttons to attack/shield.
5. Aim your attacks — they hit in the direction you're facing.
6. Use ranged attack to fire projectiles from a distance!
7. Pick up power-ups for health, damage, or shield boosts.
8. Last player (or team) standing wins!
